meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后，当你报 bug 时，它会先拉取 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码、跑最小复现、确认根因，再在对应仓库创建 GitHub issue（只对上游 Codex 可建 PR），附证据与修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交、开启或分诊 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报个 bug，附上复现步骤和根因
先搜一下有没有重复 issue，有的话把我的证据补充进去
say.note: 有匹配就改为评论，不重复开单

howto.what_en: When you report a bug it syncs LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources, runs a minimal reproduction, confirms the root cause, then files a GitHub issue in the owning repo — a PR only for upstream openai/codex — with evidence and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex bug for me, with repro steps and root cause
This Codex CLI bug reproduces on clean upstream too, file it in openai/codex
say_en.note: Routes upstream, where PRs are allowed

say_en.text: Search for an existing issue first and add my evidence as a comment
